claims: Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death worldwide.
Lung cancer originates in the lungs.
Lung cancer often originates from the air passages.
Smoking is the primary cause of lung cancer.
Smoking is responsible for 80-90% of lung cancer cases.
Symptoms of lung cancer include a persistent cough.
Symptoms of lung cancer include blood in sputum.
Symptoms of lung cancer include chest pain.
Symptoms of lung cancer include weight loss.
Diagnosis of lung cancer involves imaging with CT, PET, and MRI.
Diagnosis of lung cancer involves biopsies.
Lung cancer treatments like surgery, chemotherapy, and targeted therapies are determined by the subtype: non-small cell (NSCLC) or small cell (SCLC).
NSCLC is the most common type of lung cancer.
NSCLC accounts for about 85% of lung cancer cases.
NSCLC includes adenocarcinoma.
NSCLC includes squamous cell carcinoma.
NSCLC includes large cell carcinoma.
SCLC is less common than NSCLC.
SCLC tends to spread faster than NSCLC.
CT scans are used to identify abnormal masses in the lungs in lung cancer diagnosis.
MRI scans are used to identify abnormal masses in the lungs in lung cancer diagnosis.
PET scans are used to identify abnormal masses in the lungs in lung cancer diagnosis.
Lung cancer biopsy involves removing a sample of tissue and examining it under a microscope to confirm cancer cells.
Sputum cytology for lung cancer involves looking at sputum under a microscope to check for cancer cells.
Bronchoscopy for lung cancer involves using a camera on a thin tube to look inside the airways.
Lung cancer surgery is performed to remove the tumor and surrounding lung tissue.
Lung cancer surgery is most common in early-stage cancers.
Lung cancer chemotherapy uses drugs to kill cancer cells.
Lung cancer chemotherapy is often used for advanced disease or in combination with other treatments.
Lung cancer targeted therapies are drugs that target specific molecular features of the cancer cells.
Lung cancer targeted therapies are particularly effective in non-smokers or specific genetic mutations.
Lung cancer radiation therapy uses high-energy rays to kill cancer cells.
Lung cancer radiation therapy is often used to shrink tumors or treat symptoms.
Lung cancer immunotherapy helps the patient's own immune system fight the cancer.
Nonsmokers can develop lung cancer.
Secondhand smoke exposure significantly increases lung cancer risk.
Exposure to radon gas is a major cause of lung cancer.
Exposure to asbestos is a major cause of lung cancer.
Exposure to radon gas and asbestos is a major cause of lung cancer especially in occupational settings.
Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death in men.
Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death in women.
Overall lung cancer cases are decreasing due to lower smoking rates.
There is a rise in lung cancer cases among younger, never-smoking individuals.
